top_signals.title: Ukraine has found a new pressure point in Russia’s wartime economy
top_signals.summary: Ukraine's drone attacks on Russia's biggest online retailer Wildberries have ratcheted up the pressure on Moscow's wartime economy.

top_signals.title: ING Nears SRTs on $10 Billion of Loans Including AI-Linked Debt
top_signals.summary: ING Groep NV is hedging credit risk on about $10 billion of loans via significant risk transfers as banks worldwide bolster their use of the instruments to free up capacity for new lending.

top_signals.title: St James’s Place suffers £1bn hit to flows as investors look to dodge pension tax
top_signals.summary: St James’s Place took a £1bn hit to net inflows in the first half of the year as investors pulled cash from its funds to dodge market volatility and a looming pension tax bill.
